# gunzip

Decompress gzip data through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/gunzip -c input.txt.gz > restored.txt

moonx cli/gunzip -t input.txt.gz
```

Decode gzip members and verify checksums. Use -c to preserve file operands and write stdout.

## Common options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-c`, `--stdout` | Write to stdout and keep input files. |
| `-t`, `--test` | Validate compressed input without output. |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | Suppress trailing-garbage warnings. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

Use `--help` for the complete option list.

## Notes

- Corrupt input can produce a valid prefix before failure. Named-file replacement and metadata preservation have filesystem limits.

Build from source with the MoonBit 1.0 RC1 toolchain.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
